知识点

一次函数
browser.end_event: full actual preview/unsatisfied diagnostic, images decoded, two animation frames
browser.measurement_source: same browser monotonic performance.now; startup/login/form entry outside timing

scope.app: verified Windows worker and actual descendant process working sets; excludes experiment controller and parent redirector
scope.postgres: sum of all postgres process RSS in shared eduagent-postgres-1; not isolated database attribution; shared pages can be counted repeatedly
scope.redis: sum of all redis-server process RSS in dedicated eduagent-t179-redis-8756bb66a88f
scope.sum: independent app/PostgreSQL/Redis probes concurrently inside one complete cycle; observed sum, not unique physical or continuous peak

resources.coverage_rule: complete simultaneous component cycles inside actual action; first cycle starts within50ms; last boundary and cycle gaps <=1s +50ms scheduling tolerance; probes <=1s; one cycle allowed when action is shorter than schedule; no continuous-peak guarantee

sample_rows.observation_method: three independent probes in parallel; common cycle start/completion, actual worker subtree; no browser/controller memory in app scope

memory_budget.unit_policy: GB=1000000000 bytes; MB=1000000 bytes; display MiB=1048576 bytes
memory_budget.scope: Observed application subtree working set plus PostgreSQL/Redis process RSS. Shared pages may be counted repeatedly; not unique physical memory or EXE acceptance.

controller_window: browser monotonic duration mapped to same-host start UTC for resource selection; screenshots/cleanup excluded; elapsed always browser monotonic
